title: He led a database company for less than a year. Then Mark Zuckerberg created a role for him at Meta - reporting directly to him.

sources.text: CNBC - MongoDB's CEO steps down for senior role at Meta
ThePrint - Who is Chirantan 'CJ' Desai, Meta's new enterprise executive

caption:
He led a database company for less than a year. Then Mark Zuckerberg created a role for him at Meta - reporting directly to him.

Meta named him Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, a newly created role heading a division focused on turning Meta's AI capabilities into products for developers and businesses. Desai reports directly to CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

Before MongoDB, Desai spent nearly 8 years at ServiceNow, rising to President and COO and overseeing growth from $1.5 billion to over $10 billion in annualized revenue. He later led Product & Engineering at Cloudflare before taking the MongoDB CEO role in November 2025.

A Viksit Bharat by 2047 needs its technical leaders trusted with exactly this kind of authority - not just running a team, but defining what a company's next division even looks like.
